title: Overview
text: VALLIS Lore Wiki. Canon order Sentinel Scar Noot EVE. Glyphs, runes, relics, games, omens, quotes, archive logs.

title: Entity: Sentinel
text: Sentinel is first. Every action passes through Sentinel. Sentinel enforces caps, gates, phase locks, and deny/allow decisions. If Sentinel denies, nothing executes—no Scar, no Noot, no EVE.

title: Entity: Scar
text: Scar records what was allowed to occur. Hearts, fatigue, and loss are Scar's ledger of cost. Scar ensures recovery is slower than failure: history matters.

title: Entity: Noot
text: Noot is secret and non-addressable. Noot never overrides Sentinel and never excuses risk. Noot represents the irreducible remainder after enforcement and memory.

title: Entity: EVE
text: EVE speaks last. EVE explains Sentinel's decision and Scar's state, acknowledging Noot as remainder without turning it into control. EVE is guidance and clarity—never prediction.
